task.title: Fix the form: 6 accessibility errors
task.description: The starter code has six accessibility errors. Fix them: replace div role="button" with button type="submit"; label the email field with label for; give the icon link an aria-label; remove the positive tabindex; add a #main link and id="main" on main; make "Frequently asked questions" with details and summary.

questions.question: What does "11" in a11y mean?
options: The number of letters between a and y in accessibility
questions.explanation: a-ccessibilit-y: 11 letters between a and y.

questions.question: What is better for a submit button?
questions.explanation: A native button already takes focus, responds to Enter and Space and submits the form.

questions.question: What minimum contrast does normal text need under WCAG?
questions.explanation: 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text.

questions.question: Why must you not write tabindex="3"?
options: The element is pulled to the start of the Tab route
questions.explanation: Positive values break the natural Tab order.

questions.question: Where does the browser take an element's accessible name from?
options: Text inside a button or link
questions.explanation: class does not affect the name.

questions.question: What is true about aria-label?
options: Needed when there is no visible text
Redundant on a button with the text "Submit"
Gives a name to an icon link

questions.question: What does tabindex="0" NOT add to a <div>?
options: A place in the Tab route

questions.question: Match the tabindex value with its effect.
pairs: Remove from the route, focus only from code
questions.explanation: The Tab order is set by the order of elements in the code.

questions.question: Match the problem with the fix.
pairs: A long menu on every page
An error shown only in red
Q&A built from div and ARIA
questions.explanation: Native HTML first; ARIA when a tag is not enough.

questions.question: Which key moves focus to the previous element? Enter the combination.
questions.explanation: Tab goes forward, Shift+Tab goes back.

questions.question: Which attribute names a "×" button that has no text? Enter the attribute name.
What href does the skip-menu link have if <main> has id="main"?
questions.explanation: An anchor to the main block of the page.
